earnings.title: FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE
highlights: $489 million, a 31% increase over the same quarter of the previous year, primarily from higher operating income and a non-recurring fee earned in connection with our investment in the atNorth joint venture
Delivered record annualized gross bookings of $533 million, up 35% year over year, on robust demand and strengthening pricing

Achieved 10% year over year interconnection revenue growth on both an as-reported and a normalized and constant currency basis, with Fabric revenue up 24% year over year on both an as-reported and a normalized and constant currency basis

quotes.text: Our Q3 results and raised full-year guidance reflect the differentiated position and growing importance of Equinix.
quotes.by: Adaire Fox-Martin, CEO and President, Equinix

outlook: For the fourth quarter of 2026, the company expects revenues to range between $2.684 and $2.724 billion, an increase of 11 - 13% over the previous year on an as-reported basis, or 12 - 13% on a normalized and constant currency basis.
Adjusted EBITDA is expected to range between $1.328 and $1.368 billion, reflecting an adjusted EBITDA margin of 49 - 50%.

For the full year of 2026, total revenues are expected to range between $10.325 and $10.365 billion, an increase of approximately 12% over the previous year on both an as-reported and a normalized and constant currency basis.
Adjusted EBITDA is expected to range between $5.290 and $5.330 billion, reflecting an adjusted EBITDA margin of approximately 51%, an approximate 200 basis points expansion over the previous year.

items.heading: Geopolitical events and political tensions contribute to an already complex landscape, and could have a negative effect on our global business operations.
items.group: Risks Related to the Macro Environment

items.heading: The current uncertain economic environment, including challenges related to power and supply chains, could impact our business and the businesses of our customers.
items.group: Risks Related to the Macro Environment

items.heading: Our business could be harmed by increased costs to procure power, prolonged power outages, shortages or capacity constraints.
items.group: Risks Related to the Macro Environment

items.heading: Any failure of our physical infrastructure or negative impact on our ability to meet our obligations to our customers, or damage to customer infrastructure within our IBX data centers, could lead to significant costs and disruptions that could reduce our revenue and harm our business reputation and financial condition.

We experienced cybersecurity incidents in the past and may be vulnerable to future security breaches, which could disrupt our operations and have a material adverse effect on our business, results of operation and financial condition.

We are currently making significant investments in our back-office information technology systems and processes. Difficulties from or disruptions to these efforts may interrupt our normal operations and adversely affect our business and results of operations.
